item.title: Weekend Forecast
item.description: Best surf: Capitola, Sunday, November 1 at 11 AM — 6.5 alone / 7.5 with instructor, tied for the top score with 1 PM, with light offshore wind and enough runway before the beach face; the modeled 3.2 ft face remains above the current 2.5 ft demonstrated limit. Best jump: Skydive California, Saturday, October 31 at 9 AM — the smoothest slot, with 2 mph wind, 7 mph gusts, and dry conditions. All times local.
